capabilities: Render Sankey diagrams from code blocks in notes
Drag and drop nodes to reorder them
Disable automatic node alignment in settings
extras: The README shows a Catppuccin color palette is used; plugin settings include a toggle for a relaxation algorithm and automatic alignment.
intentEvidence: Tired of sankey generators putting nodes out of order? Drag and drop them back in position or disable the automatic alignment
motivation: The author was tired of Sankey generators putting nodes out of order, so Finkey lets users drag nodes back into place or disable automatic alignment.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to create Sankey flow diagrams, and existing generators force an automatic node ordering that users cannot adjust.
summary: Sankey diagram generator that renders interactive flow diagrams in notes from a finkey code block, with draggable node ordering.
